verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs say the Sentry team builds and maintains official SDKs for most popular languages and frameworks. There are documented per-platform SDKs for Android, Apple (sentry-cocoa), .NET, Dart and Elixir, plus a documented SDK API for custom event reporting. An official agent plugin also teaches Claude Code, Cursor and Codex to install and configure the SDK. Missing for 10: an official typed client SDK for the management/REST API (only a published OpenAPI schema is evidenced), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality across languages.
